description: UPME’s repository implements a Colombian energy model using OSeMOSYS. The documentation describes spreadsheet-to-CSV preparation, local solver runs and a frontend/backend workflow for managing scenarios and results. The provider is UPME Subdirección de Demanda. Coverage: Coverage is Colombia as stated in the repository identity. Exact model regions, time horizon and source-data vintage are not established by the integration guide. Access: The public repository and its integration README were read. They describe Python, GLPK or HiGHS, CSV inputs and optional Docker services; nothing was run. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The documentation warns that incomplete input processing can produce failures or inconsistent results. The exact source licence and data rights were not established. For simulation it supports preparation and optimisation of Colombian energy scenarios. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this UPME implementation.
